scale.source: only if the brief fixes a scale for this drawing and there is no frame in panel-layout/layout.json: <brief file> p. N; left empty, 1:500

panel_width_mm.source: the panel's width from the brief's checklist: <brief file> p. N; left empty, the width is not checked

floor_height_m.source: only for buildings without height_m: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: why; left empty, 3 m, marked as assumed
